name: Clarence (Block: lock, Brace: off-balance)
concept: The rules v12 starter: one of nearly every kind of move. Draft, from rules-overview 12. HP and speeds are placeholders, and the Super and eighth card are still to decide.
notes: Slash 4/1 and Dive 5/1 (+2 chip if it beats a Convert), from the 25 October 2026 balance pass. Counter replaced by Brace, a second Guard: if it beats a Pressure, the opponent is off-balance and can't play a Recover next round. Block also locks: if it beats a Pressure, that Pressure goes one space further on cooldown.
